input.quote: 22.3 A Party may at any time assign, sell or transfer the whole of' its rights and obligations under this Agreement to:
input.rationale: Paragraph 22 is symmetric: it binds every APCN 2 Party (including us) on identical terms, so nothing here is a one-sided restriction on the customer. Subparagraph 22.3 gives each Party a consent-free right to assign the whole of its rights and obligations to a successor, a Parent Company, a Subsidiary or Affiliate, or another Subsidiary/Affiliate of its Parent Company, which delivers the affiliate and successor/M&A carve-out the preferred position requires; 22.4 and 22.5 add further intra-group partial assignment rights. Any other assignment under 22.2 requires Management Committee consent that "must not unreasonably withhold or delay its approval" — the preferred consent standard — and 22.6 requires only timely written notice for the permitted transfers. Paragraph 30 (p0269) binds successors and permitted assigns, confirming assignments survive. Searches for "change of control" and "control" return no provision giving any Party a termination, re-pricing or exit right on another Party's change of control, so the walk-away risk is absent. Minor points noted but not flagged: 22.3 covers only assignment of the whole interest (partial intra-group assignments under 22.4 are limited to one per Assignee and do not release the Assignor), and there is no express bar on assignment to a competitor — neither is material given the consortium structure and the symmetric drafting.
